t.en: Use the Gram-Schmidt procedure to find an orthogonal basis of a subspace of an inner product space.
t.zh: 用施密特正交化（Gram-Schmidt procedure）求内积空间某个子空间的正交基。

t.en: Find an orthonormal basis of a subspace.
t.zh: 求子空间的标准正交基。

t.en: Although we have already seen some potential uses for orthogonal bases, we have not yet seen very many examples of such bases. In this section, we will look at the Gram-Schmidt orthogonalization procedure, a method for turning any basis into an orthogonal one.
t.zh: 前面我们已经看到正交基的一些潜在用处，但还没有见到多少这样的基的例子。这一节来学习施密特正交化（Gram-Schmidt orthogonalization procedure），这是一种把任意一个基变成正交基的方法。

t.en: The basic idea is very simple: if two vectors $\vect{v}_1,\vect{v}_2$ are not orthogonal, then we can make them orthogonal by replacing $\vect{v}_2$ by a vector of the form $\vect{u}_2 = \vect{v}_2 - t\vect{v}_1$, for a suitable parameter $t$.
t.zh: 基本想法非常简单：如果两个向量 $\vect{v}_1,\vect{v}_2$ 不正交，那么可以把 $\vect{v}_2$ 换成形如 $\vect{u}_2 = \vect{v}_2 - t\vect{v}_1$ 的向量，其中 $t$ 是一个合适的参数，这样就能使它们正交。

t.en: But what is the correct value of $t$? It turns out that this value is uniquely determined by the requirement that $\vect{v}_1$ and $\vect{u}_2$ must be orthogonal. We calculate
t.zh: 那么 $t$ 的正确取值是多少呢？事实上，要求 $\vect{v}_1$ 与 $\vect{u}_2$ 正交，就唯一地确定了这个值。我们计算

t.en: Setting this equal to $0$ yields the unique solution
t.zh: 令它等于 $0$，得到唯一的解

t.en: Note that this is exactly the same thing as the Fourier coefficient of $\vect{v}_2$ in the direction of $\vect{v}_1$. The following proposition summarizes what we have found so far. For consistency with our later notation, we also rename the first basis vector $\vect{v}_1$ to $\vect{u}_1$.
t.zh: 注意，这恰好就是 $\vect{v}_2$ 在 $\vect{v}_1$ 方向上的傅里叶系数。下面的命题总结了到目前为止的发现。为了与后面的记号一致，我们还把第一个基向量 $\vect{v}_1$ 改记为 $\vect{u}_1$。

t.zh: 则 $\set{\vect{u}_1,\vect{u}_2}$ 是 $W$ 的一个正交基。

t.en: The procedure for finding an orthogonal basis of a $k$-dimensional space is very similar. We adjust each basis vector $\vect{v}_i$ by subtracting a suitable linear combination of previous orthogonal basis vectors.
t.zh: 求 $k$ 维空间的正交基，步骤非常类似：对每个基向量 $\vect{v}_i$，减去前面已得到的正交基向量的一个合适的线性组合，对它进行调整。

title.zh: $k$ 个向量的施密特正交化

t.en: Let $\set{\vect{v}_1,\ldots,\vect{v}_k}$ be a basis for some subspace $W$ of an inner product space $V$. Define vectors $\vect{u}_1,\ldots,\vect{u}_k$ as follows:
t.zh: 设 $\set{\vect{v}_1,\ldots,\vect{v}_k}$ 是内积空间 $V$ 的某个子空间 $W$ 的一个基。按如下方式定义向量 $\vect{u}_1,\ldots,\vect{u}_k$：

t.en: Then $\set{\vect{u}_1,\ldots,\vect{u}_k}$ is an orthogonal basis of $W$.
t.zh: 则 $\set{\vect{u}_1,\ldots,\vect{u}_k}$ 是 $W$ 的一个正交基。

t.en: First, it is clear that $\set{\vect{v}_1,\ldots,\vect{v}_k}$ and $\set{\vect{u}_1,\ldots,\vect{u}_k}$ span the same subspace, as each $\vect{v}_i$ is a linear combination of $\vect{u}_1,\ldots,\vect{u}_i$ and conversely, each $\vect{u}_i$ is a linear combination of $\vect{v}_1,\ldots,\vect{v}_i$. So the only thing we must check is that $\set{\vect{u}_1,\ldots,\vect{u}_k}$ is an orthogonal set. In other words, we must show that $\iprod{\vect{u}_j,\vect{u}_i}=0$ for all $j<i$. We prove this by induction on $i$, i.e., we assume it is already true for all pairs of indices smaller than $i$. To show $\iprod{\vect{u}_j,\vect{u}_i}=0$, we calculate:
t.zh: 首先，$\set{\vect{v}_1,\ldots,\vect{v}_k}$ 与 $\set{\vect{u}_1,\ldots,\vect{u}_k}$ 张成同一个子空间，这是因为每个 $\vect{v}_i$ 都是 $\vect{u}_1,\ldots,\vect{u}_i$ 的线性组合，反过来，每个 $\vect{u}_i$ 也都是 $\vect{v}_1,\ldots,\vect{v}_i$ 的线性组合。所以只需再检验 $\set{\vect{u}_1,\ldots,\vect{u}_k}$ 是正交向量组。换句话说，我们要证明：对所有 $j<i$ 都有 $\iprod{\vect{u}_j,\vect{u}_i}=0$。我们对 $i$ 用归纳法来证明，也就是假设对所有小于 $i$ 的下标对，结论已经成立。为了证明 $\iprod{\vect{u}_j,\vect{u}_i}=0$，我们计算：

t.en: It follows that the set $\set{\vect{u}_1,\ldots,\vect{u}_k}$ is orthogonal, as desired.
t.zh: 由此得出向量组 $\set{\vect{u}_1,\ldots,\vect{u}_k}$ 是正交的，这正是所要证明的。

t.en: The Gram-Schmidt procedure is sensitive to reordering the vectors. For example, if we order the original basis vectors in Example “Gram-Schmidt orthogonalization procedure” in the opposite order, we end up with a different orthogonal basis at the end. Sometimes this can simplify the calculations, as the following example shows.
t.zh: 施密特正交化对向量的排列顺序很敏感。例如，如果把例“施密特正交化”中原来的基向量按相反的顺序排列，最后得到的正交基就不同。有时这样做可以简化计算，下面的例子就是如此。

t.en: The Gram-Schmidt procedure yields an *orthogonal* basis. If we want to compute an *orthonormal* basis, we also have to normalize each basis vector. Since normalization usually involves dividing by a square root, it is best to do this at the end, i.e., after the entire Gram-Schmidt procedure is complete, rather than normalizing each $\vect{u}_i$ immediately after it is found. Note that the Gram-Schmidt procedure itself does not involve computing any square roots.
t.zh: 施密特正交化得到的是*正交*基。如果想要得到*标准正交*基，还需要把每个基向量单位化。单位化通常要除以一个平方根，所以最好放在最后做，也就是等整个施密特正交化过程结束之后再做，而不是每求出一个 $\vect{u}_i$ 就立刻单位化。请注意，施密特正交化本身并不需要计算任何平方根。

t.en: Find an orthonormal basis for the subspace of $\R^3$ from Exercise 〔引用〕.
t.zh: 求习题 〔引用〕 中 $\R^3$ 的那个子空间的一个标准正交基。

t.en: The orthonormal basis is $\displaystyle\set{ \frac{\vect{u}_1}{\norm{\vect{u}_1}}, \frac{\vect{u}_2}{\norm{\vect{u}_2}} } = \set{ \frac{1}{\sqrt{14}} \left[\begin{array}{c} 1 \\ 2 \\ 3 \end{array}\right], \frac{1}{\sqrt{26}} \left[\begin{array}{c} 1 \\ 4 \\ -3 \end{array}\right] }$.
t.zh: 标准正交基为 $\displaystyle\set{ \frac{\vect{u}_1}{\norm{\vect{u}_1}}, \frac{\vect{u}_2}{\norm{\vect{u}_2}} } = \set{ \frac{1}{\sqrt{14}} \left[\begin{array}{c} 1 \\ 2 \\ 3 \end{array}\right], \frac{1}{\sqrt{26}} \left[\begin{array}{c} 1 \\ 4 \\ -3 \end{array}\right] }$。
